# 1. INTRODUCTION
# 1. 引言
$^{7}$ The focus of the first papers in this literature, Acemoglu (1998) and Kiley (1999), was to investigate when and why technology could be biased toward skilled workers. Later Acemoglu (2003b) and Jones (2005) studied similar ideas to investigate why technical change may be purely labor-augmenting. Acemoglu (2003a), Xu (2001), Gancia (2003), and Thoenig and Verdier (2003) used versions of this framework to investigate the effect of international trade on the bias of technology.
$^{7}$ 这一文献中最早的两篇论文，即 Acemoglu (1998) 与 Kiley (1999)，关注的是技术何时以及为何会偏向熟练工人。后来 Acemoglu (2003b) 与 Jones (2005) 研究了类似的思想，以考察技术变化为何可能是纯劳动增强型的。Acemoglu (2003a)、Xu (2001)、Gancia (2003) 以及 Thoenig and Verdier (2003) 使用该框架的若干版本研究了国际贸易如何影响技术的偏向。
